::: {.portada}
Since 1997, the Mexican National Electoral Study (ENEM-CIDE) has published information on the behavior of the public and voters in the federal elections held every three years in Mexico. The information is obtained through surveys conducted with the highest methodological quality. All studies include a *Comparative Study of Electoral Systems* (CSES) module that links the project to a wide range of electoral studies around the world. ENEM's mission is to provide information that meets the needs of researchers, professors, students, journalists and anyone interested in better understanding the results of each election.
:::
